MAGIC_RING_RELIC.title: Magic Ring
MAGIC_RING_RELIC.description:
At the start of combat, your lose [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
At the start of your turn, you gain [gold]Energy[/gold].
BLASPHEMOUS_STATUE.title: Blasphemous Statue
BLASPHEMOUS_STATUE.description:
At the start of combat, add [gold]Dazed[/gold], [gold]Mind Rot[/gold] and [gold]Beckon[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
At the start of your turn, add [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and you gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold].
